description: This Java class 'PlaylistItem' manages the state and properties of a media item within a playlist, including identifiers, URI, MIME type, playback status, position, duration, timestamp, and remote item ID. It provides methods to set and get these properties, as well as generating a status object representing the current state.

classes.name: PlaylistItem
classes.description: Final class representing a media item in a playlist with properties such as IDs, URI, MIME type, state, position, duration, timestamp, and remote ID. Provides methods to modify and retrieve these properties, and generate a media item status.

methods.name: PlaylistItem
methods.description: Constructor that initializes a new PlaylistItem with session ID, item ID, URI, MIME type, and update receiver, setting the timestamp to the current elapsed real-time.

methods.name: setPosition
methods.description: Sets the current position within the media content.

methods.name: setTimestamp
methods.description: Sets the timestamp for when the status was last updated.

methods.name: setDuration
methods.description: Sets the total duration of the media content.

methods.name: getUri
methods.description: Returns the URI of the media item.

methods.name: getUpdateReceiver
methods.description: Returns the PendingIntent used for updates.

methods.name: getTimestamp
methods.description: Returns the timestamp of the last update.

methods.name: getStatus
methods.description: Constructs and returns a MediaItemStatus object representing the current status.

methods.name: toString
methods.description: Returns a string summary of the PlaylistItem, including IDs, current remote ID, playback state, and URI.
